commit_edge_verification.method: Fetch the exact immutable object from the official Git remote; re-hash its raw commit body as a Git commit object; parse its tree header; require the parsed tree to equal rev-parse <commit>^{tree}; run git fsck --strict.

resolver.name: value-pi-csswg-root-seed-resolver
resolver.query: At immutable CSSWG commit c7573530343759ace8e46438a1fa2c44515b5554, include css-2026/Overview.bs as scope evidence; parse exactly the top-level <dt> TR links in the four stability-band <dl> blocks bounded by the frozen section markers; normalize only the five declared TR-slug aliases; resolve Overview.bs then Overview.src.html then Overview.html inside the same Git tree; union the 21 explicit owner family roots from seed v1; de-duplicate by exact source path; sort by unsigned UTF-8 path bytes; then let PB0 follow normative grammar-bearing dependencies.

snapshot_parser.item_rule: within each exact band slice, inspect only the first membership <dl>; split top-level <dt> entries; collect and de-duplicate https://www.w3.org/TR/<slug>/ links from each <dt> header before its <dd>
snapshot_parser.metadata_rule: Parse each metadata key from its own physical header line only; a blank Level: value normalizes to the string sentinel none and must never consume the following Status:, Work Status:, or other key.
excluded_sections: CSS Current Work external live catalog
Safe to Release pre-CR Exceptions as whole-module membership; exact normative feature references remain PB0 closure inputs
CSS Levels, Profiles, responsible-implementation policy, and media-type prose

resolver.canonical_order: roots sorted by exact_path as unsigned UTF-8 bytes; routed_family_ordinals ascending numerically; snapshot band arrays retain declared order; exact_paths inside each band sort by unsigned UTF-8 bytes
resolver.raw_source_verification: SHA-256 and byte count from the HTTPS response must equal SHA-256 and byte count of git show <verified_commit>:<exact_path>; Git blob OID independently recorded

manifest_digest_method.payload: the entire parsed JSON object with the top-level manifest_content_digest field removed
manifest_digest_method.canonicalization: recursively sort every JSON object key by JavaScript code-unit order; preserve array order; serialize with JSON.stringify and no insignificant whitespace; hash the UTF-8 bytes
manifest_digest_method.implementation: Node.js canonical(value): arrays map canonical; object keys Object.keys(value).sort(); JSON.stringify(canonical(payload))
